searchText: > And I guess in terms of sending the transaction, you don't need to re-sign it? Just like how in MetaMask you can "speed up" your transaction? No need to resign. This is unlike MetaMask speed up which actually does resign. All transactions can be included without any wallet/app upgrade, they just will overpay on gas. <@489256758989029405> if we remove the transition period we actually need less buy-in from wallets because we will be able to include legacy transactions indefinitely. Deprecating the legacy transaction format will be a separate process that can be achieved via a legacy tax or something but would be out of scope for 1559. <@!301186049323958275> if we remove the transition period the target gas used becomes the gas limit from the header of the parent always ? <@574864862338088960> Yes, in principle. I think the spec may re-order things a bit though, I forget. Ok thanks We restarted the network with the latest base fee computation <@!543900561460822016> can you try the sender tool on one of the Besu nodes of the testnet ? unfortunately i need to begin shifting to a different project, i'm sorry i wasn't able to be more helpful on the 1559 testnet! > unfortunately i need to begin shifting to a different project, i'm sorry i wasn't able to be more helpful on the 1559 testnet! <@!543900561460822016> no worries. thank you <@!489256758989029405> please tell me when you get the chance to implement the latest basefee computation have you launched the new network? I am trying to connect now changed the algorithm but have a state root mismatch on 271, will check further block 271: transaction: 0xd6ff54823e5d977593d1cad4acc7be213f8cfb2e4a8c91b50f1d3a9aacef794e incorrect block construction - EIP1559 gas limit exceeded <@489256758989029405> what is the miner voted value in the block header? 10,003,262? If so, that means the upper limit is over 20M gas (2x the miner voted value). The miner voted value (formerly named block gas limit) is now colloquially named gas_target, and the "limit" is 2x the target.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content:
> And I guess in terms of sending the transaction, you don't need to re-sign it? Just like how in MetaMask you can "speed up" your transaction?
No need to resign.  This is unlike MetaMask speed up which actually does resign.  All transactions can be included without any wallet/app upgrade, they just will overpay on gas.

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: <@489256758989029405> if we remove the transition period we actually need less buy-in from wallets because we will be able to include legacy transactions indefinitely.  Deprecating the legacy transaction format will be a separate process that can be achieved via a legacy tax or something but would be out of scope for 1559.
